blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Post-hoc out-of-distribution detection usually relies on a single signal extracted from a frozen classifier, such as confidence, energy, features, or gradients. This dependence becomes fragile under classifier-level adversarial shift, where the shift can preserve the detector's chosen cue while changing the model's decision behavior. We investigate whether this failure mode can be mitigated by combining complementary detection criteria instead of selecting a single score. We introduce TriScore, a post-hoc OOD detector that combines three ID-calibrated signals from the same frozen backbone: an energy prior, a boundary-fragility score, and a transform-consistency score. These signals are standardized on ID validation data and fused by an input-dependent ID-residual gate, requiring no OOD labels, auxiliary model, training, or stored feature bank. Across four ImageNet-scale backbones, TriScore achieves the best mean AUROC among 15 post-hoc baselines under a non-adaptive adversarial-shift protocol, while remaining competitive on standard OOD benchmarks. Ablations show that the gains come from combining complementary cues rather than optimizing a single detector signal. These results support multi-criterion post-hoc detection as a practical route toward more robust OOD detection under classifier-level shift. The source code is publicly available at github.com/gursoyege/TriScore.
blocks.zh: 热出分流后检测通常依赖于从被冻结的分解器中提取出单个信号,如置信度,能量,特征等或梯度等. 这种依赖性在分类器级对抗性转变下会变得脆弱,这种转变可以在改变模型的决定行为的同时保留探测器所选择的提示. 我们调查这种故障模式是否可以通过合并补充检测标准而不是选择一个分数来缓解. 我们引入了TriScore,一种后Hoc OD探测器,它结合了来自同一被冻结的骨干上的三个ID校正信号:能量前置,边界弱点分,变相一致性分. 这些信号在ID验证数据上被标准化,并被一个依赖输入的ID-留守门接通,不需要OOD标签,辅助型号,训练,或存储的特征库. 在4个ImageNet规模的骨干中,TriScore在非适应性对抗-过渡协议下的15个Hoc后基线中实现了最佳平均AUROC,同时在标准OOD基准上保持竞争力. 膨胀表明,收益来自将互补的提示组合起来,而不是优化单一的探测器信号. 这些结果支持了多克后分解检测,作为在分解器级移位下更强的OD检测的实用途径. 源代码在github.com/gursoyege/TriScore上公开.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Modern vision systems often reuse a trained backbone across datasets, tasks, and deployment settings. Post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detection methods help in those cases, where the classifier has already been fixed and the detector must rely on the outputs or internal signals of the existing classifier without retraining it or using OOD data.
blocks.zh: 现代愿景系统经常在数据集、任务和部署设置中重复使用经过培训的骨干。 在那些分类器已经固定且探测器必须依靠现有分类器的输出或内部信号而不对其进行再培训或使用分类器数据的情况下,分流后(OD)检测方法会有所帮助。

blocks.en: Many post-hoc detectors are built around a primary cue, such as softmax confidence ( Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2017 ) , logit energy ( Liu et al., 2020 ) , activation statistics ( Sun et al., 2021 ; Djurisic et al., 2023 ) , feature distance ( Sun et al., 2022 ) , or gradient magnitude ( Huang et al., 2021 ) . Each cue emphasizes a different property of the same classifier. A detector built around only one of these cues therefore has little redundancy when a shift happens to preserve that particular statistic, even when other classifier signals are affected.
blocks.zh: 许多后热探测器都是围绕一个主提示而建造的,如软磁悬浮置信度(Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2017),对数能量(Liu等人, 2020),激活统计(Sun等人, 2021; Djurisic等人, 2023),特征距离(Sun等人, 2022),或梯度(Huang等人, 2021). 每个提示都强调同一分类器的不同属性. 因此,当一个变化发生于保存该特定统计数据时,即使其他分类信号受到影响时,仅围绕其中之一而建的探测器也几乎没有冗余。

blocks.en: This lack of redundancy is most visible under classifier-level adversarial shift. These are not detector-adaptive attacks, but they provide a demanding stress test for post-hoc detectors, since the image remains close to an in-distribution sample while the classifier response changes by design. In this setting, several strong baselines become difficult to distinguish from random guessing on at least one backbone, and the backbone on which a baseline collapses differs across baselines.
blocks.zh: 这种缺乏冗余的情况在分类级对抗性转变中最为明显。 这些并不是探测器适应性攻击,而是为后热探测器提供了要求很高的压力测试,因为图像仍然接近于内分泌样本,而分类器的反应则通过设计而改变. 在此情况下,若干强基线难以与至少一个骨干上的随机猜测区分开来,基线崩溃的骨干因基线而异。

blocks.en: TriScore addresses this lack of redundancy, extracting three signals from the same frozen classifier. The energy branch measures abnormal logit evidence after subtraction of a class-mean logit vector estimated from ID calibration data. The Boundary-Probe branch estimates local decision fragility from a top- k k logit margin and the gradient of that margin at a late feature representation. The transform-consistency branch measures whether mild deterministic views lead to stable predictive distributions. These branches are complementary as they fail for different reasons: Energy is cheap and strong on many semantic shifts, Boundary-Probe responds to locally fragile decisions even when the logit magnitude remains plausible, Transform consistency detects predictions that are unstable under benign views.
blocks.zh: TriScore解决了这种缺乏冗余的问题,从同一个冷冻分类器中提取了三个信号. 能量分支在减去从ID校准数据中估计的类-正数矢量后测量异常的对数证据. 边界-勘探分支估计,当地决定的脆弱性从最高-k千对数比值和较晚的特征表示率梯度来估计。 变相一致性分支衡量温和的确定性观点是否导致稳定的预测分布. 这些分支互为补充,因为它们因不同原因而失败: 能源价格低廉,而且在许多语义变化中很强。 边界-Probe对当地脆弱的决定作出反应,即使数值数量仍然合理。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : TriScore attaches to a frozen classifier. It computes class-centered energy, Boundary-Probe fragility, and transform consistency, then fuses the standardized branch scores using an ID-residual gate. Calibration uses ID validation data only.
blocks.zh: 图1:TriScore附在冷冻分类器上。 它计算以类为主的能量,边界-概率脆弱性,并转化一致性,然后使用ID-剩余门将标准化分支分数引信. 校准只使用ID验证数据.

blocks.en: After the three signals are computed, TriScore fuses them with a calibrated rule. Each branch is calibrated on ID validation data, which determines the typical behavior for that branch. At test time, the final score gives more weight to branches whose standardized score exceeds the ID-typical range. Calibration does not use OOD examples, and the method does not train an auxiliary model. An overview of our method is shown in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 在计算出三个信号后,TriScore用校准规则将其引信. 每个分支在ID验证数据上进行校准,这决定了该分支的典型行为. 在测试时间,最终得分给标准化得分超过ID-典型范围的分支更多的权重. 校准不使用OOD实例,方法也不训练辅助模型. 图1概述了我们的方法。

blocks.en: We evaluate TriScore in the OpenOOD framework on four ImageNet-scale backbones: ResNet-50, RegNet, ViT-B/16, and Swin-T ( He et al., 2016 ; Radosavovic et al., 2020 ; Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) . The evaluation uses near-OOD and far-OOD datasets ( Bitterwolf et al., 2023 ; Vaze et al., 2022b ; Van Horn et al., 2018 ; Cimpoi et al., 2014 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and adversarial-shift data ( Goodfellow et al., 2015 ; Kurakin et al., 2018 ; Madry et al., 2018 ; Dong et al., 2018 ; Zheng et al., 2019 ; Croce and Hein, 2020 ; Carlini and Wagner, 2017 ; Moosavi-Dezfooli et al., 2016 ; Andriushchenko et al., 2020 ; Athalye et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们评价OpenOOD框架的TriScore:ResNet-50、RegNet、Vit-B/16和Swin-T四个规模的图像网络主干线。 (He等人,2016年;Radosavovic等人,2020年;Dosovitskiy等人,2021年;Liu等人,2021年). 评估使用了近OD和远OOD数据集(Bitterwolf等人,2023年;Vaze等人,2022年b;Van Horn等人,2018年;Cimpoi等人,2014年;Wang等人,2022年;Zhang等人,2024年),以及对抗转换数据。 (Goodfellow等人,2015年;Kurakin等人,2018年;Madry等人,2018年;Dong等人,2018年;Zheng等人,2019年;Croce和Hein,2020年;Carlini和Wagner,2017年;Moosavi-Dezfooli等人,2016年;Andreushchenko等人,2020年;Athalye等人,2018年).

blocks.en: TriScore provides a stronger adversarial-shift robustness floor than the individual post-hoc methods. The per-attack analysis shows that this result is not driven by a single attack, and the transformer results show lower cross-attack variance than the closest competitors.
blocks.zh: TriScore比个别的后期方法提供了更强的对抗-轮式强健性底线. 每一次攻击分析显示,这一结果并非由一次攻击所驱动,变压器结果显示的交叉攻击差异比最接近的竞争对手要小.

blocks.en:
Our contribution is a practical post-hoc detector for frozen classifiers, together with a controlled study of how energy, boundary fragility, and consistency under deterministic transforms interact under clean and adversarial shift. We make the following claims: (i) TriScore combines three frozen-backbone signals under ID-only calibration and remains compatible with standard OpenOOD post-hoc evaluation.
(ii) under our non-adaptive adversarial-shift protocol, TriScore gives the best mean AUROC among 15 post-hoc baselines on all four ImageNet-scale backbones, and the best mean FPR@95 on three of four.
(iii) the gain is broad across attack families. TriScore wins 27 of 40 attack × \times backbone AUROC cells and 19 of 40 FPR@95 cells, and it has lower cross-attack AUROC standard deviation on multiple backbones.
(iv) the ablation study shows that the proposed branches improve over their closest predecessor-style alternatives and that the fusion provides an ID-only way to combine them.
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献是对冷冻分级器的实用的后热探测器,同时对确定性变换下的能量、边界脆弱性和一致性如何在清洁和对抗性变换下相互作用进行控制性研究。 我们提出以下主张: (一)TriScore将三个冷冻的后骨信号结合到只有ID的校准下,并保持与标准OpenOOD的后热评价兼容.
(二) 根据我们的非适应性对抗性临时协议,TriScore在所有四个ImageNet尺度主干线的15个后基线中给出了最佳平均AUROC,在四个中的三个中给出了最佳平均FPR@95。
(三) 收益在攻击家庭范围很广。 TriScore赢得了40个攻击×\times骨干AUROC细胞中的27个和40个FPR@95细胞中的19个,它在多个骨干上具有较低的交叉攻击AUROC标准偏差.
(四)消化研究显示,拟议的分支比它们最接近的前作风格的替代品有所改进,聚变提供了一种仅以ID为主的结合方式.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Post-hoc OOD detection scores a frozen classifier without parameter changes. The earliest and still widely used baseline is maximum softmax probability, which treats low maximum confidence as OOD evidence ( Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2017 ) . ODIN improves this output-space view with temperature scaling and a small input perturbation ( Liang et al., 2018 ) . Later work showed that logits often carry stronger OOD information than normalized softmax probabilities. The maximum logit score uses the largest pre-softmax logit ( Hendrycks et al., 2022 ) , energy-based detection uses log-sum-exp free energy ( Liu et al., 2020 ) , and GEN studies generalized entropy scores at scale ( Liu et al., 2023 ) . These methods are efficient and architecture-agnostic, which makes them strong baselines for any post-hoc method.
blocks.zh: 后Hoc OOD检测得分 一个冻结的分类器没有参数变化. 最早和仍然广泛使用的基线是最大软马克思概率,它将低最大置信度作为OOD证据处理(Hendrycks and Gimpel, 2017.). ODIN通过温度缩放和少量输入扰动改进了这种输出-空间视图(Liang等人,2018年). 后来的研究表明,logits往往携带比正常的软马克思概率更强的OD信息. 最大对数分数使用最大的软体前对数(Hendrycks等人,2022年),基于能量的检测使用对数和Exp自由能量(Liu等人,2020年),GEN在尺度上研究一般对数(Liu等人,2023年). 这些方法是高效的和结构不可知的,这使得它们成为任何后热方法的强基线.

blocks.en: A second line of work uses internal network information rather than only final logits. GradNorm uses gradients from a uniform-target objective as an OOD signal ( Huang et al., 2021 ) . ReAct and ASH modify late activations by clipping or sparsification before scoring ( Sun et al., 2021 ; Djurisic et al., 2023 ) . DICE changes the effective classifier weights at test time ( Sun and Li, 2022 ) , and SCALE revisits activation shaping through activation rescaling ( Xu et al., 2024 ) . Feature-space methods use the geometry of ID representations. KNN measures nearest-neighbor distance in deep feature space ( Sun et al., 2022 ) . ViM combines the residual outside a principal ID feature subspace with the original logits ( Wang et al., 2022 ) . NCI uses neural-collapse-inspired class geometry ( Liu and Qin, 2025 ) , while CADRef measures class-aware feature discrepancies relative to classifier-weight directions ( Ling et al., 2025 ) . TriScore is motivated by the fact that these cues are useful, but each one is incomplete on its own.
blocks.zh: 第二行的工作使用内部网络信息,而不只是最后的登录。 GradNorm使用统一目标目标的梯度作为OOD信号(Huang等人,2021年). ReAct和ASH在评分前通过剪接或溅射来修改迟发激活(Sun等人,2021年;Djurisic等人,2023年). DICE在测试时间改变有效的分类器重量(Sun和Li,2022年),SCALE通过激活缩放(Xu等人,2024年)重新审视激活形状. 特征-空间方法使用ID表示的几何. KNN测量深度地物空间近邻距离(Sun等人,2022年)。 ViM将主ID特征子空间外的剩余部分与原始对数(Wang等人,2022年)结合. NCI使用神经-螺旋-激发的类几何(刘和秦,2025年),而CADRef测量类-认知特征相对于分类器-重量方向的差异(Ling等人,2025年). TriScore的动机是,这些提示是有用的,但每个提示都是不完全的.

blocks.en: The consistency branch is related to test-time augmentation and distributional disagreement. Test-time augmentation often improves prediction or calibration under benign shifts ( Shanmugam et al., 2021 ) , and Jensen-Shannon divergence is a standard symmetric comparison between predictive distributions ( Lin, 1991 ) . We use this idea in a post-hoc setting. Our branch compares a base prediction with two mild deterministic views and treats distributional instability as OOD evidence.
blocks.zh: 一致性分支与测试时间的增强和分配分歧有关. 试验时间增强常改善良性转变下的预测或校准(Shanmugam等人,2021年),詹森-沙农差异是预测分布之间的标准对称比较(Lin,1991年). 我们用这个想法 在后热的环境下。 我们的分支将一个基础预测与两个温和的决定性观点进行比较,并将分布不稳定性作为OD证据.

blocks.en: Several OOD methods alter the classifier during training. Outlier Exposure trains with auxiliary outlier data ( Hendrycks et al., 2019 ) , and energy-based losses can also serve as training objectives ( Liu et al., 2020 ) . These approaches are highly effective when retraining and auxiliary OOD data are allowed. They are outside our deployment setting, where the classifier is frozen and the detector must be added after training.
blocks.zh: 几种OD方法在训练中改变了分类器. 具有辅助外部数据的外部接触列车(Hendrycks等人,2019年),基于能源的损失也可作为培训目标(Liu等人,2020年)。 在允许再培训和辅助OD数据时,这些方法非常有效。 他们不在我们的部署范围之外,在那里,分类器被冻结,在训练后必须添加探测器.

blocks.en: Robustness-oriented OOD detection is closest to our motivation. PRO searches locally around each input for a perturbation that minimizes the OOD score, then uses the resulting score as a robustness-aware detector ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . TriScore instead uses fixed forward passes and late-feature backward passes rather than iterative test-time search. The adversarial stress tests in our evaluation draw from the standard attack literature, with FGSM, BIM, PGD and momentum variants, AutoAttack and APGD, C&W, DeepFool, Square, and BPDA-based attacks ( Goodfellow et al., 2015 ; Kurakin et al., 2018 ; Madry et al., 2018 ; Dong et al., 2018 ; Zheng et al., 2019 ; Croce and Hein, 2020 ; Carlini and Wagner, 2017 ; Moosavi-Dezfooli et al., 2016 ; Andriushchenko et al., 2020 ; Athalye et al., 2018 ) . Certified robust OOD detection has also been studied ( Meinke et al., 2022 ) , but our work makes an empirical post-hoc claim, not a certified one.
blocks.zh: 强力面向OD检测最接近我们的动机. PRO 环绕每个输入进行局部搜索,以获得尽量减少OD分数的扰动,然后将所得分数作为强力感知探测器(Chen等人,2025年)。 TriScore则使用固定前传和后传后传,而不是迭代测试时间搜索. 我们评价中的对抗性压力测试来自标准攻击文献,有FGSM,BIM,PGD和动力变体,AutoAttack和APGD,C&W,DeepFool,Square,以及基于BPDA的攻击(Goodfellow等人,2015年;Kurakin等人,2018年;Madry等人,2018年;Dong等人,2018年;郑等人,2019年;Croce和Hein,2020年;Carlini和Wagner,2017年;Moosavi-Dezfooli等人,2016年;Andrishchenko等人,2020年;Athalye等人,2018年). 也研究了经认证的强力OD检测(Meinke等人,2022年),但我们的工作是经验性的事后索赔,而不是经认证的索赔。

blocks.en: We follow current OpenOOD and full-spectrum evaluation practice ( Yang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ) . For adversarial generation, the evaluation uses the OpenOOD attack-data interface which uses AutoAttack and Foolbox to generate these attacks ( Rauber et al., 2017 ; Croce and Hein, 2020 ) . ImageNet-scale near-OOD evaluation uses SSB-Hard and NINCO ( Vaze et al., 2022b ; Bitterwolf et al., 2023 ) , and far-OOD evaluation uses iNaturalist, Textures, and OpenImage-O ( Van Horn et al., 2018 ; Cimpoi et al., 2014 ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Smaller-scale OSR and generalized OOD studies use CIFAR-10, Tiny ImageNet, and MNIST ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ; Le and Yang, 2015 ; LeCun et al., 1998 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Vaze et al., 2022a ) . Since post-hoc detector behavior changes with architecture, we evaluate both convolutional and transformer backbones, with ResNet, RegNet, ViT, and Swin ( He et al., 2016 ; Radosavovic et al., 2020 ; Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们遵循目前的OpenOD和全谱评价做法(杨等人,2022年;张等人,2024年;杨等人,2023年). 对于对抗性一代,评价使用OpenOOD攻击数据接口,使用AutoAttack和Foolbox生成这些攻击(Rauber等人,2017年;Croce和Hein,2020年). 图像 网尺度近食评价采用SSB-Hard和NINCO(Vaze等人,2022b;Bitterwolf等人,2023),远食评价采用iNaturalist,Textures,和OpenImage-O(Van Horn等人,2018年;Cimpoi等人,2014年;Wang等人,2022年;张等人,2024年). 小规模 OSR和通用OOD研究使用CIFAR-10,Tiny ImageNet和MNIST(Krizhevsky,2009年;Le and Yang,2015年;LeCun等人,1998年;Yang等人,2024年;Vaze等人,2022a年)。 由于后热探测器行为随建筑而变化,我们评价了革命和变压器骨干,有ResNet,RegNet,VIT,和Swin(He等人,2016年;Radosavovic等人,2020年;Dosovitskiy等人,2021年;Liu等人,2021年).

blocks.en: In our method, the energy branch adapts EBO ( Liu et al., 2020 ) with subtracting an ID-estimated class-mean logit vector (Eq. ( 2 )). The Boundary-Probe is based on standard top- k m k_{m} margin, the specificity of the branch is the ratio of the margin to its late-feature gradient as one fragility scalar (Eq. ( 5 )), which differs from GradNorm’s uniform-target gradient magnitude ( Huang et al., 2021 ) and from margin-only scores. The consistency branch adapts test-time augmentation and Jensen-Shannon divergence ( Shanmugam et al., 2021 ; Lin, 1991 ) to a post-hoc OOD score. Another new element is the fusion, which is a per-sample, OOD-label-free combiner keyed on how far each standardized branch exceeds its ID-tail quantile (Section 3.4 ). Our method contributes through the integration and design of the ID-residual gate, together with the empirical finding (Section 4.2 ) that diverse ID-only fusion provides a robust detection method. Appendix B.6 further investigates whether the same baseline can be achieved by fusing other existing detectors.
blocks.zh: 在我们的方法中,能量分支对EBO(Liu等人,2020年)进行调整,减去一个ID估计的类-平均值对数矢量(Eq. (2 )). 边界-Probe基于标准上-k m k_{m}比值,分支的特异性是比值与其后期梯度作为1个脆弱阶梯(Eq. (5 ))的比值,这与GradNorm的统一目标梯度(Huang等人,2021年)和只比值的分数不同. 一致性分支将测试时间增强和詹森-沙农差异(Shanmugam等人,2021年;Lin,1991年)调整为Hoc OD后分数. 另一个新元素是聚变,它是按每个标准化分支在多大程度上超过其ID-尾部四分位数(第3.4节)键的每样无OD-标签结合器。 我们的方法通过整合和设计ID留守门,以及经验发现(第4.2节),即多样化的ID单聚能提供一种强力的检测方法,来作出贡献。 附录B.6进一步调查是否可以通过引信其他现有探测器来实现同样的基线.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We consider post-hoc OOD detection for a frozen image classifier f : ℝ C × H × W → ℝ K f:\mathbb{R}^{C\times H\times W}\to\mathbb{R}^{K} with logits z ⁡ ( x ) ∈ ℝ K z(x)\in\mathbb{R}^{K} . TriScore assigns a scalar score S ⁡ ( x ) S(x) , where larger values indicate stronger evidence that x x is OOD. The classifier weights are not updated, and calibration uses only an ID validation split. This setting matches common deployment constraints in which a trained classifier is available, but OOD samples and auxiliary outlier data are not.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑对冷冻图像进行HOC OD检测 f: R C × H×W×R K:\mathbb{R×C}\times H×Times W×to\mathbb{R×K}使用logits z×(x)×(x)×R K(x)\in\mathbb{R×K}. TriScore指定一个S QQ(x) S(x)分数,其中较大的值表示xx是OOD的更有力证据. 分类器权重不更新,校准只使用ID验证分解. 这种设置符合通常的部署限制,即有训练有素的分类器可用,但OD样本和辅助外部数据不可用。

blocks.en: We combine three calibrated views of the same frozen classifier. The Energy (E) branch measures whether the logit vector looks atypical after removing persistent class-wise offsets. The Boundary-Probe (BP) branch estimates local decision fragility by combining a top- k k margin with the gradient of that margin at a late feature representation. The Transform-Consistency (TC) branch measures whether the predictive distribution changes under mild deterministic views. These branches are normalized on ID data and fused with an ID-residual gate that gives more weight to whichever branch is most atypical for the current input.

blocks.en: Assumption 1: The ID calibration split 𝒟 ID \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{ID}} should represent the deployment-time ID distribution, since it determines the branch means, standard deviations, and quantiles. blocks.en: An energy signal is a scalar summary of the full logit vector. Instead of keeping only the largest softmax probability, it uses log-sum-exp to combine the evidence assigned to all classes. For classifier logits z ⁡ ( x ) z(x) , the standard raw energy score is E raw ( x ; T ) = − T log ∑ k = 1 K exp ( z k ​ ( x ) T ) E_{\mathrm{raw}}(x;T)=-T\log\sum_{k=1}^{K}\exp\!\Big(\frac{z_{k}(x)}{T}\Big) (1) This is the standard energy-based OOD formulation used by EBO ( Liu et al., 2020 ) . It is efficient as it only requires the logits already produced by the classifier, and it is stronger than maximum softmax probability in many large-scale settings as it preserves logit-scale information ( Hendrycks et al., 2022 ) .

blocks.en: The limitation is that raw logits in a frozen classifier can include persistent class-wise offsets inherited from training. Some classes receive systematically larger logits on ID data even when the evidence for a particular input is not stronger. A raw energy score can therefore mix input-level OOD evidence with reusable class-level logit bias. This is related to the logit-scale calibration effects studied in recent OOD work ( Djurisic et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 限制是,冷冻分类器中的原始对数可以包括从培训中继承下来的持续的班级抵消。 某些类在识别数据上收到系统较大的日志,即使某项输入的证据不强。 因此,原始能量分数可以将输入级OOD证据与可重复使用的类级对数偏差混为一谈. 这与近期的OD工作中研究的对数尺度校准效应有关(Djurisic等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: The standard margin method uses the negative margin as OOD evidence, since a smaller margin indicates a more ambiguous prediction. blocks.en: The limitation is however, the margin-only and gradient-only scores are incomplete. Test-time augmentation (TTA) entropy variance checks whether the entropy changes across augmentations ( Shanmugam et al., 2021 ) . These are useful as they require only additional forward passes and no retraining.

blocks.en: The issue is that both summaries discard information. Argmax disagreement changes only after the top class flips, so it misses smaller but systematic distributional shifts. Entropy variance can remain small when probability mass moves among classes with similar entropy. For OOD detection, these partial summaries can miss instability in the predictive distribution.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en: The evaluation is designed to test the three-branch score against existing post-hoc detectors and measures its stability across architectures and shifts. We use the OpenOOD framework and compare against 15 post-hoc baselines. The baseline set is restricted to detectors that can be attached to the same frozen classifier, without auxiliary OOD data or retraining, because this is the deployment setting TriScore targets. Within that constraint, the methods cover the main post-hoc families: output and logit scores (MSP, MLS, EBO, ODIN, GEN), activation or classifier-weight shaping (ReAct, ASH, DICE, SCALE), gradient or local-robustness scores (GradNorm, PRO), and feature-geometry scores (KNN, ViM, NCI, CADRef). Most baselines are stock OpenOOD postprocessors, CADRef and PRO are integrated locally as recent strong post-hoc baselines, and TriScore and its branch ablations are added as OpenOOD-compatible postprocessors. The main ImageNet-scale evaluation uses ResNet-50, RegNet, ViT-B/16, and Swin-T. These backbones span a residual CNN, a modern convolutional architecture, a plain vision transformer, and a hierarchical transformer.
blocks.zh: 该评价旨在对照现有的后热探测器测试三分支分数,并测量其跨建筑和转向的稳定性. 我们使用OpenOOD框架,并与15个热量后基线进行比较。 基准集仅限于可以附加在同一冷冻分类器上的探测器,没有辅助OD数据或再培训,因为这是设定TriScore目标的部署. 在这一限制范围内,这些方法覆盖了主要的职业后家庭:产出和登录分数(MSP、MLS、EBO、ODIN、GEN)、激活或分类器重塑造(ReAct、ASH、DICE、SCALE)、梯度或局部波动分数(GradNorm、PRO)和特征几何分数(KNN、VIM、NCI、CADRef)。 大多数基线是库存的OpenOOD后处理器,CADRef和PRO是作为最近强效的Hoc后处理器在当地整合的,TriScore及其分支的分流被添加为OpenOOD兼容后处理器. 主要图像网尺度评价使用ResNet-50,RegNet,Vit-B/16,以及Swin-T. 这些骨干横跨一个残余的CNN,一个现代革命建筑,一个平坦的视觉变压器,以及一个等级变压器.

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmarks and protocols
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准和协议

blocks.en: Following OpenOOD, ImageNet-1K provides the ID data. Near-OOD evaluation uses SSB-Hard and NINCO, and Far-OOD evaluation uses iNaturalist, Textures, and OpenImage-O. TriScore estimates its class-mean logits, branch statistics, temperatures, quantiles, and gate parameters from an ID-only calibration subset of at most 5,000 images. OOD or adversarial examples are not used for calibration. Additional CIFAR-10 OOD checks and open-set recognition checks on CIFAR-6, CIFAR-50, TIN-20, and MNIST-6 are reported in Appendices F.1 and F.2 .
blocks.zh: 在OpenOOD之后,ImageNet-1K提供ID数据. 近OD评价使用SSB-Hard和NINCO,远OD评价使用iNaturalist,Textures,和OpenImage-O. TriScore从一个最多为5000个图像的ID唯一校准子集中估算出其类正数,分支统计,温度,量子和门参数. 不使用OD或对抗性实例进行校准。 附录F.1和F.2中报告了对CIFAR-6、CIFAR-50、TIN-20和MNIST-6进行的额外CIFAR-10OD检查和开放式识别检查。

blocks.en: The adversarial-shift benchmark follows OpenOOD’s ImageNet attack-data interface ( Yang et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , with an extended local suite used for evaluation. Foolbox and AutoAttack provide the model wrapper and misclassification-criterion interface for the supported attacks. Attacks are generated against the frozen ImageNet classifier with ImageNet labels, and the resulting perturbed ImageNet images are evaluated as shifted inputs against clean ImageNet ID images. The attacker does not optimize TriScore, the branch scores, or the gate.
blocks.zh: 对抗-过渡基准如下: OpenOOD的ImageNet攻击数据接口(Yang等人,2022年;Zhang等人,2024年),其扩展的本地套房用于评价. Foolbox和AutoAttack为所支持的攻击提供了模型包装和错误分类-标准接口. 攻击是针对与ImageNet标签的冻结的ImageNet分类器产生的,由此产生的扰动的ImageNet图像被评价为相对于干净的ImageNetID图像的转移输入. 攻击者不优化TriScore,分支分数,或门.

blocks.en: We use AutoAttack (AA), APGD-CE, C&W, DeepFool, FGSM, masked PGD (M-PGD), PGD, Square, BIM, and PGD-BPDA. This attack set is chosen to cover single-step and iterative gradient attacks, optimization-style attacks, decision-boundary attacks, black-box query attacks, masked/local perturbations, BPDA-style attacks, and an AutoAttack ensemble. It extends the default ImageNet attack-script suite used in OpenOOD with PGD-BPDA and AutoAttack-family attacks in the evaluated adversarial-OOD protocol. The ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} attacks use ϵ = 4 / 255 \epsilon=4/255 , while C&W and DeepFool follow their OpenOOD/Foolbox ℓ 2 \ell_{2} implementations. Appendix A gives more details on these attacks.

blocks.en: We report FPR@95 and AUROC. Following the OpenOOD evaluator, OOD is treated as the positive class and the true positive rate is the fraction of OOD samples detected. FPR@95 is then the false positive rate, i.e. the fraction of ID samples flagged as OOD, at the threshold where the OOD true positive rate first reaches 95% (lower is better). AUROC is the area under the ROC curve and equals the probability that a randomly chosen OOD sample receives a higher score than a randomly chosen ID sample (higher is better). Because this FPR@95 threshold is fixed by the OOD score distribution, it is in general distinct from a fixed ID operating point.
blocks.zh: 我们报告FPR@95和AUROC。 在OpenOOD评估后,OD被作为阳性类处理,真实阳性率是检测到的OD样本的一小部分. FPR@95是假阳性率,即标记为OOD的ID样本的一小部分,处于OO真实阳性率首先达到95%的阈值(较低更好). AUROC是ROC曲线下的区域,等于随机选择的OOD样本得到比随机选择的ID样本更高的分数(更高更好)的概率. 由于这个FPR@95阈值是由OOD得分分配确定的,因此一般来说它不同于一个固定的ID操作点.

blocks.en: The per-attack tables in Appendix C.2 show that the aggregate result is not caused by a single attack. Across the 40 attack × \times backbone cells, TriScore gives the best AUROC in 27 cells. The FPR@95 view is more competitive because PRO is explicitly optimized for perturbation robustness. TriScore still has the best FPR@95 in 19 of 40 cells, compared with 16 for PRO, and it has the best mean FPR@95 on three of four backbones in Table 1 . The nearest competitors are attack-specific. NCI is strongest on several ResNet-50 optimization attacks, DICE is strong on parts of Swin-T, and GEN is competitive on several transformer cells. The pattern supports the intended role of TriScore as a broad robustness-floor detector, not necessarily a detector specialized to one attack family.

TriScore在40个单元格中的19个单元格中仍然拥有最好的FPR@95,而PRO只有16个,在表1的4个主干线中,它拥有最优的FPR@95。 最近的竞争者都是针对攻击的 NCI在几个ResNet-50优化攻击上最强,DICE在Swin-T的部分上最强,GEN在几个变压器电池上具有竞争力. 这种模式支持TriScore作为广泛的强力底部探测器的预期作用,不一定是专门用于一个攻击家族的探测器.

blocks.en: A second useful statistic is cross-attack variance. On Swin-T, TriScore has a per-attack AUROC standard deviation of 4.5, compared with 5.5 for GEN and 6.9 for DICE. On ViT-B/16, TriScore has standard deviation 5.5, compared with 6.6 for GEN and 5.8 for DICE. Some lower-mean baselines such as PRO or MSP have smaller variance, so the stability claim is relative to the high-AUROC competitors. This matters because adversarial OOD deployments do not usually know the attack family in advance. A method with high mean performance and moderate attack-to-attack dispersion can be preferable to a method that wins on one attack and collapses on another.
blocks.zh: 第二个有用的统计数据是交叉攻击差异。 在Swin-T上,TriScore的每个攻击AUROC标准偏差为4.5,而GEN为5.5,DICE为6.9. 在VIT-B/16上,TriScore有标准偏差5.5,而GEN为6.6,DICE为5.8. 一些低度基线,如PRO或MSP,差异较小,因此稳定性主张与高AUROC竞争对手相对. 这一点很重要,因为敌对的OD部署通常不事先了解攻击家庭. 一种具有高中性能和中度攻击对攻击散射的方法可以比一种在一次攻击上获胜和在另一次攻击上崩溃的方法更可取.

blocks.en: The same argument applies across backbones. In Table 1 , TriScore’s worst-backbone mean AUROC is 62.1 62.1 (on ResNet-50), which is higher than the worst-backbone AUROC of every one of the fifteen baselines, the best baseline floor is PRO at 59.4 59.4 , and the rest fall further, several below 50 50 (GradNorm 47.0 47.0 , ODIN 47.8 47.8 ). TriScore never drops below 62 62 AUROC under adversarial shift, whereas each baseline has at least one backbone on which it does. Therefore it holds its robustness floor across architectures.
blocks.zh: 同一论点适用于各支柱。 在表1中,TriScore最差背骨平均AUROC为62.1 62.1(ResNet-50),高于15个基线中每个基线中最差背骨AUROC,最佳基线底座是PRO为59.4 59.4,其余的则进一步下降,几座低于50(GradNorm 47.0 47.0,ODIN 47.8 47.8)。 TriScore在对抗性班次下从未下降至62,62 AUROC以下,而每个基线至少有一个支柱。 因此,它保持整个建筑层的坚固。

blocks.en: Under this adversarial-shift protocol, TriScore gives the strongest mean AUROC across the evaluated backbones and the best mean FPR@95 on three of four, with lower cross-attack dispersion than the closest high-AUROC competitor on transformer backbones. Appendix E.3 identifies the mechanism behind this floor. The branch correlations are heterogeneous across backbones: on ResNet-50 several pairs are correlated on clean ID data and decorrelate substantially under attack, while on RegNet and the transformer backbones the branches are already weakly correlated on clean data and remain weak-to-moderate under attack. In both regimes the branch errors overlap only partially, so the fusion degrades where single scores fail. Appendix B.6 asks whether the same floor is reachable by fusing other existing detectors, and Appendix D reports the adaptive attacks.
blocks.zh: 根据这种对抗-过渡协议,TriScore在评价的骨干上给出了最强的AUROC中位数,在四强中给出了最强的FPR@95中位数,交叉攻击散射率低于变压器骨干上最接近的高AUROC竞争者. 附录E.3确定了这一层背后的机制。 分支的关联性因骨干而异:在ResNet-50上,若干对与干净的ID数据相关联,而且装饰在很大程度上受到攻击,而在RegNet和变压器骨干上,分支与清洁数据的关系已经很薄弱,而且仍然处于薄弱到中度的攻击之下。 在两种制度中,分支错误只部分重叠,因此在单分失败时核聚变. 附录B.6询问同一层是否可以通过安装其他现有探测器达到,附录D报告了适应性攻击.

blocks.en: 4.3 Standard OOD detection
blocks.zh: 4.3 标准OD检测

blocks.en: Table 2 reports clean ImageNet-1K OOD detection for each of the four standard backbones under the group-mean protocol defined above. It includes both the final gated TriScore and the E+BP branch subset so that the comparison distinguishes the main detector from the simpler two-branch configuration analyzed in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 表2报告清洁图像 网-1K OOD 检测 上面定义的集团-意协议下的4个标准主干线中的每个. 它既包括最终的门形TriScore,也包括E+BP分支子集,这样比较就可以区分主探测器和附录B分析的更简单的两分支配置.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Clean-OOD detection results for each backbone.
blocks.zh: 表2:每个骨干部的清洁食品检测结果。

blocks.en:
The strongest clean baselines vary by architecture: SCALE is strongest on ResNet-50 in this table, GEN is strongest on RegNet, and CADRef is strongest on ViT-B/16 and Swin-T.
The E+BP TriScore variant is a lower-cost clean-OOD alternative, while the final gated detector has better clean FPR@95 on all four backbones in this table.
blocks.zh:
最强的清洁基线因架构而异:SCALE在本表的ResNet-50上最强,GEN在RegNet上最强,CADRef在Vit-B/16和Swin-T上最强.
E+BP Triscore变体是一种成本较低的清洁-OOD替代品,而最终的闸门探测器在本表中所有四个主干线上都有更好的清洁FPR@95.

blocks.en: The results show that TriScore’s main advantage is not clean-OOD dominance; it is the stronger adversarial-shift floor in Table 1 . On the four-backbone clean mean AUROC, seven baselines score above TriScore’s 82.67 82.67 (CADRef 87.12 87.12 , GEN 86.23 86.23 , ViM 85.44 85.44 , PRO 83.84 83.84 , KNN 83.48 83.48 , NCI 83.43 83.43 , and MLS 82.76 82.76 ). TriScore is mid-pack on clean-OOD because it does not use the richer ID-training feature geometry that CADRef and ViM exploit, and that geometry is exactly what helps on standard semantic and texture shifts. The residual gate is designed to act where a branch is driven into its ID tail (Section 3.4 ). On clean-OOD, where the branches stay near their ID-typical range, it reduces toward an equal-weight average and adds little, so the gated detector is competitive rather than dominant here.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,TriScore的主要优势不是清洁食品的主导地位;而是表1中较强的对抗性轮班制。 在四个背骨上,平均AUROC有七个基线比TriScore的82.67(CAD Reform 87.12,GEN 86.23 86.23,VIM 85.44 85.44,PRO 83.84 83.84,KNN 83.48,NCI 83.43 83.43,和MLS 82.76 82.76 ) 。 TriScore是清洁食品的中间组合,因为它没有使用CAD Ref和Vim开发的更丰富的ID-训练特征几何学,而几何学正是对标准语义和纹理转变的帮助。 剩余大门的设计是为了在某一分支被驱动进入其ID尾部时采取行动(第3.4节)。 在干净的OOD中,如果树枝停留在它们的ID-典型范围附近,它会降低到相等的重量平均值,而增加的很少,因此,有门的探测器具有竞争力,而不是在这里占据支配地位。

blocks.en: The clean-OOD advantage of the strongest feature-based baselines also comes at a cost and fails to transfer among them. CADRef, ViM, and KNN each lose 26 26 - 28 28 AUROC from clean to adversarial averaged over the four backbones (versus TriScore’s 16.9 16.9 ), and their adversarial AUROC ( 55 55 - 63 63 ) falls below TriScore’s ( 62 62 - 72 72 ) on every backbone. All three require access to the ID-training features at setup, and KNN additionally retains and searches the full 1.28 1.28 M-vector feature bank at inference (detailed in Appendix B.5 ), whereas TriScore calibrates on ID-validation statistics only and stores no bank. The closest baseline overall is GEN, a cheap logit score that beats TriScore on clean-OOD and is the strongest adversarial baseline on the transformer backbones. TriScore wins over GEN on adversarial AUROC on all four backbones. TriScore therefore trades a few points of clean AUROC for a stronger and lighter adversarial-shift floor.
blocks.zh: 以特征为基础的最强基线的清洁-OED优势也付出了代价,未能在它们之间转移。 CADRef、Vim和KNN各损失26 26 - 28 28 AUROC, 在四个主干线上平均从清洁到对抗性(相对于TriScore的16.9 16.9), 其对抗性AUROC(55 55 - 63 63)在每个主干线上低于TriScore(62 - 72 72). 所有这三项规定都需要在设置时访问ID训练功能,KNN还额外保留和搜索了完整的1.28 1.28 M-vector特性库,推论(详见附录B.5),而三分数校准则只用于ID-验证统计,没有存储任何银行. 最近的基线总体是GEN,这是一个廉价的对数分数,在清洁-OOD上比TriScore还强,也是变压器骨干上最强的对抗基准. TriScore胜过GEN 在对抗性AUROC所有四个骨干。 因此,TriScore以几分干净的AUROC换取一个更有力、更轻的对抗性轮班底。

blocks.en: The E+BP row is included as a simpler deployment variant. Empirically, E+BP has slightly higher AUROC than the gated TriScore on ResNet-50 and RegNet, while the gated detector has higher AUROC on ViT-B/16 and Swin-T and lower FPR@95 on all four backbones. Therefore, E+BP provides a cheaper alternative in clean-OOD, while the gated three-branch TriScore remains the main detector for adversarial shift.
blocks.zh: E+BP列作为一个更简单的部署变体被列入. 从经验上看,E+BP在ResNet-50和RegNet上的AUROC比有门的TriScore稍高,而有门的探测器在ViT-B/16和Swin-T上的AUROC更高,在所有四个骨干上的FPR@95更低. 因此,E+BP在清洁食品中提供了一个更便宜的替代品,而门式的三分支TriScore仍然是对抗性转向的主要探测器.

blocks.en: The same table also shows a stability advantage that is easy to miss from mean rankings alone. Several baselines have a severe architecture-specific failure on at least one backbone. ASH falls to 52.38 52.38 AUROC on ViT-B/16, GradNorm to 56.86 56.86 on RegNet, DICE to 54.46 54.46 on Swin-T, and SCALE to 66.97 66.97 on ViT-B/16. TriScore remains at or above 80 80 AUROC on all four standard backbones in the clean summary. FPR@95 shows the same stability pattern but not dominance. TriScore stays below 66 66 FPR@95 on all four backbones, while ASH, GradNorm, DICE, and SCALE each exceed 90 90 FPR@95 on at least one backbone. This cross-architecture floor is a useful property for post-hoc deployment, where the detector is often attached after the classifier architecture has already been chosen.
blocks.zh: 同一表还显示一个稳定优势,仅靠平均排名就很容易错过. 一些基线至少有一个主干存在严重的建筑特异性故障。 ASH在Vit-B/16上降为52.38 52.38 AUROC,在RegNet上降为56.86 56.86,在Swin-T上降为54.46 54.46,在SCALE上降为66.97 66.97. TriScore在清版摘要中所有四个标准骨干上保持在80 AUROC以上. FPR@95显示的稳定性模式相同,但并非支配地位。 TriScore在所有四个骨干上保持在66°66′FPR@95以下,而ASH,GradNorm,DICE,和SCALE在至少一个骨干上各超过90°90′FPR@95. 这层跨结构的地层是Hoc后部署的有用属性,在分类器架构已经选定后,探测器经常被附着.

blocks.en: TriScore is not the clean-OOD winner, but it remains competitive and avoids the most severe architecture-specific failures. For clean-OOD deployment, the E+BP variant is the lower-cost TriScore choice, while the final gated detector is the main TriScore variant used for adversarial-shift robustness.
blocks.zh: TriScore虽然不是干净的OOD赢家,但依然具有竞争力,避免了最严重的建筑特异性失败. 对于清洁-OOD部署,E+BP的变体是成本较低的TriScore选择,而最终的闸门探测器是用于对抗-转向稳健性的主要TriScore变体.

blocks.en: Full per-dataset ImageNet baseline results are reported in Appendix C.1 , and gated and equal-weight TriScore variants are separated in Appendices B – C.4.2 .
blocks.zh: 每个数据集 ImageNet基准结果在附录C.1中报告,门式和等重的TriScore变量在附录B – C.4.2中分离.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: TriScore is designed for frozen classifiers, ID-only calibration, and the non-adaptive classifier-level adversarial-shift protocol described in Section 4.1 . Therefore, it is not a certified detector, and it is not robust to an adaptive detector-aware adversary as shown in Appendix D . However, on the same TriScore-targeted adversarial examples, several standard differentiable baselines (EBO, MLS, MSP, GEN, GradNorm) also show high transfer evasion as those attacks were not separately optimized against each baseline. This can be interpreted as transfer evasion, consistent with the adaptive-attacks literature. We explicitly scope the robustness claim to the non-adaptive setting and treat detector-aware robustness as out-of-scope.
blocks.zh: TriScore是为冷冻分类器,只用于ID校准,以及第4.1节所述非适应性分类器级对抗-转移协议设计的. 因此,它不是一个经过认证的探测器,对于一个适应性的探测器-意识的对手来说,它并不强大,如附录D所示。 然而,在同一三S计分对抗性例子中,若干标准不同基线(EBO、MLS、MSP、GEN、GradNorm)也显示出高水平的转移逃逸率,因为这些攻击没有按照每个基线单独优化。 这可以解释为逃避转移,符合适应性攻击的文献. 我们明确将强性要求的范围扩大到非适应性的设定,并将探测器的强性视为超出范围。

blocks.en: The method is strongest when the deployment setting rewards redundancy across logit energy, local boundary fragility, and transform consistency. Clean-OOD benchmarks do not always require all three cues. In the latest branch-combination ablation, the ungated equal-weight E+BP+TC variant has the strongest clean aggregate, while E+BP remains a lower-cost alternative when the extra transform-consistency computation is undesirable. The final gated TriScore should be preferred when robustness to the evaluated adversarial-shift protocol is the primary objective.
blocks.zh: 当部署的设定奖励了对数能量的冗余、局部边界的脆弱性以及改变一致性时,这种方法最强。 清洁食品的基准并不总是需要所有三个提示。 在最新的分支集成衰减中,加成的等重E+BP+TC变体具有最强的清洁聚合物,而当额外的变换一致性计算不可取时,E+BP仍然是一个成本较低的替代品. 如果对评估的对抗性临时协议的稳健性是首要目标,则应优先采用最终锁定的TriScore。

blocks.en: The branch behavior is also architecture dependent. On ResNet-50, the energy signal is weak under adversarial shift, and BP-only is better than the full combination. On RegNet, ViT-B/16, and Swin-T, the full combination is more effective. These results suggest that a practical implementation should include a lightweight branch diagnostic before deployment. The current paper uses the ablation evidence to state this rule manually. An automatic ID-only diagnostic for deciding between BP, E+BP, and E+BP+TC remains future work.
blocks.zh: 分支行为也依赖于架构. 在ResNet-50上,在对抗性转向下能量信号很弱,仅BP比全组合更好. 在RegNet,Vit-B/16,和Swin-T上,完全组合效果更高. 这些结果表明,实际执行应包括部署前的轻量级分支诊断。 本文使用绝缘证据手动说明这一规则. 在BP、E+BP和E+BP+TC之间作出决定的自动识别诊断仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: Appendix B.4 reports a grid sweep over the quantile levels and softness and a 5-seed calibration study. The ranking is stable, and calibration-subset variability is small (standard deviation ≤ 0.07 \leq 0.07 AUROC across backbones, one to two orders of magnitude below the Table 1 margins). This bounds calibration-subset noise but not finite-test-set or attack-generation randomness, which we quantify with paired per-image bootstrap intervals in Appendix E.4 ; close 1 1 - 2 2 AUROC margins should be read with that scope in mind. The quantile levels and softness are fixed ID-only defaults. A backbone-adaptive softness could improve the gate, but we do not tune it without OOD validation data. We also do not report threshold-dependent metrics beyond FPR@95, so fixed-threshold deployment should calibrate the operating point on a held-out ID split.
blocks.zh: 附录B.4报告了对四分位水平和软度的网格扫描以及5种种子的校准研究。 排名稳定,校准-子集可变性很小(标准偏差 ^ 0.07\leq 0.07 AUROC跨主干线,1至2个数量级低于表1边际). 这种校准-子集噪声,但不包括有限测试-集或攻击-生成的随机性,我们在附录E.4中用成对的每幅图框间隔加以量化;在读近1 1 - 2 2 AUROC边值时应考虑到这一范围。 量子级和软度是固定的仅ID默认值. 骨干适应软能改善门,但是没有OOD验证数据我们不会调谐. 我们也不报告超过FPR@95的阈值计量标准,因此固定阈值部署应该将操作点校准在搁置的ID拆分上.

blocks.en: Boundary-Probe is high for locally fragile decisions, and hard ID examples can also be locally fragile. Appendix E.2 provides the diagnostic. On clean ID data, BP is strongly related to softmax confidence and predicts ID misclassification, so it behaves largely as a hard-example cue. Its independent value appears under shift, where the component of BP orthogonal to MSP still separates adversarial OOD. BP is thus redundant with uncertainty on clean data and complementary to it under attack, which is the regime the method targets.
blocks.zh: 边界-勘探对于当地脆弱的决定来说是很高的,硬身份证的例子也可能是当地脆弱的。 附录E.2提供了诊断结果。 在干净的ID数据上,BP与软马克思置信度密切相关,并预言ID的分类错误,因此它主要表现为硬实例提示. 其独立价值似乎正在转移,其中BP正交向MSP的成分仍然将对抗性OOD分开. 因此,BP是多余的,对清洁数据缺乏把握,并且是对受到攻击的补充,而攻击是方法目标的制度。

blocks.en: TriScore is also more expensive than single-forward detectors. It uses three forward passes and three late-feature backward passes per input. For latency-critical settings, E-only or E+BP variants provide lower-cost alternatives.
blocks.zh: TriScore也比单向探测器更昂贵. 它使用3个前传和3个后传后传每输入. 对于耐久性临界设置,只有E-或E+BP变体提供成本较低的替代品.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: TriScore is a post-hoc OOD detector that attaches to a frozen classifier and combines three ID-calibrated signals, namely class-centered logit energy, Boundary-Probe fragility, and Jensen-Shannon transform consistency. The method uses no OOD labels, auxiliary model, retraining, or stored ID-training feature bank. The feature-geometry detectors it competes with need ID-training access at setup, and some of them must search the full feature bank at inference. TriScore instead stores one class-mean logit vector and a small set of scalar ID-validation statistics, with no feature bank. It has no training-set dependency at deployment and is significantly faster than the heaviest baseline. Its main design principle is redundancy. A single confidence cue can be preserved by a shift or perturbation, while a combination of logit evidence, boundary fragility, and view consistency is harder to satisfy simultaneously.
blocks.zh: TriScore是一个Hoc OD后探测器,它附着在冷冻的分类器上,并结合了三个ID校准信号,即以类为中心对数能量,边界-Probe脆弱,和Jensen-Shannon转换一致性. 该方法没有使用OOD标签,辅助模型,再培训,或存储的ID-训练特征库. 它在设置时与需要的ID-训练访问进行竞争的特征-几何探测器,其中一些必须推论搜索完整的特征库. TriScore转而存储一个类-平均值对数向量和一套小的scalar ID-验证统计,没有特性库. 它在部署时没有训练方面的依赖,而且大大快于最重的基线。 其主要设计原则是冗余. 一个单一的置信提示可以通过移位或扰动来保存,而结合对数证据,边界脆弱性,以及视图一致性则更难同时满足.

blocks.en: Across four ImageNet-scale backbones and 15 post-hoc baselines, TriScore obtains the best mean AUROC in the non-adaptive adversarial-shift protocol on all four backbones and the best mean FPR@95 on three of four. Its robustness floor holds across architectures as the worst-backbone exceeds the worst-backbone of every baseline, the detector never collapses on a particular backbone unlike the individual cues. It also gives lower cross-attack AUROC variance on the two transformer backbones, which indicates a more uniform robustness floor than the closest high-AUROC competitor. On standard OOD benchmarks, the method remains competitive and avoids several severe architecture-specific failures, although specialized clean-OOD baselines are often stronger on clean-OOD alone.
blocks.zh: 在4个ImageNet规模主干线和15个Hoc后基线中,TriScore在所有4个主干线上获得非适应性对抗性临时协议中的最佳平均AUROC,在3个主干线上获得最佳平均FPR@95。 其坚固的楼层支撑着整个建筑,因为最坏的背骨超过了每个基线中最坏的背骨,探测器从未像单个提示一样在某个特定的骨干上崩溃. 这也使得两个变压器主干线上的AUROC发生较低的交叉攻击偏差,这表明比最接近的高AUROC竞争对手更一致的稳健性地板. 在标准OOD基准上,该方法仍然具有竞争力,避免了几种针对特定建筑的严重故障,尽管专门的Gean-OOD基线往往仅靠Gean-OOD更强.

blocks.en: The ablation studies clarify where the gains come from. Boundary-Probe improves over margin-only and GradNorm-style alternatives, and JS-TC improves over simpler transform-consistency baselines. Class-centered energy is best viewed as a calibrated logit prior for fusion rather than a standalone replacement for EBO. The branches are partly redundant under clean shift, where the ungated E+BP+TC variant gives the strongest fixed-subset aggregate and E+BP is a lower-cost alternative. They are more complementary under adversarial shift, where the full gated detector is stronger on backbones with a usable energy signal.
blocks.zh: 消化研究明确了收益来源. 边界-Probe改进了仅差值和GradNorm型替代品,而JS-TC则改进了较简单的转换-一致性基线。 以阶级为中心的能量最好被看作是核聚变前的校准记录,而不是EBO的独立替代. 分支在清洁转向下部分冗余,其中加挂的E+BP+TC变体给出了最强的固定子集,E+BP是一种成本较低的替代品. 在对抗性的转变下,它们更具互补性,在有可用能量信号的骨干上,全门探测器更强大。

blocks.en: The main open directions are defenses against detector-aware attackers (e.g. randomized or non-differentiable gate variants that do not expose a clean gradient path), automatic branch diagnostics that select BP, E+BP, or E+BP+TC for a given backbone from ID-only signals, transform pools that better handle texture-like OOD and smooth optimization-based perturbations, and ImageNet-scale latency for the multi-view scoring. These extensions would turn TriScore from a strong post-hoc adversarial-shift detector into a complete robust OOD detection.
blocks.zh: 主要开放方向是针对探测器意识攻击者的防御(如随机或无区别的门变体不暴露干净梯度路径),选择BP,E+BP,或E+BP+的自动分支诊断. TC用于给定的主干线,来自ID专用信号,变换能更好地处理纹理类OD和光滑优化基扰动的池,以及多视图评分的ImageNet比例空档. 这些扩展将使TriScore从一个强力的后对抗性转向式探测器变成一个完全强大的OD探测器.

blocks.en: This section collects the protocol details that are easy to miss from the tables in the main text.

blocks.en: TriScore uses only an ID calibration subset of at most 5,000 examples from the OpenOOD ID validation loader to estimate class-mean logits, branch means and standard deviations, temperature choices, branch quantiles, and gate parameters. Detector metrics are computed with the OpenOOD ID test loader and the corresponding OOD loaders. OOD or adversarial images are not used for calibration. Main clean-OOD and ablation summaries follow the OpenOOD convention used in our scripts. Near-OOD datasets are averaged as a group, Far-OOD datasets are averaged as a group, and the reported mean averages the two groups. Adversarial summaries average the 10 attack-specific metrics listed in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: Triscore只使用OpenOOD ID验证加载器中最多5,000个实例的ID校准子集来估计类-正数对数,分支手段和标准偏差,温度选择,分支四分位数,以及门参数. 用OpenOODID测试加载器和相应的OOD加载器计算出检测器的度量衡. OD或对抗图像不用于校准. 主要的清洁-OOD和消毒摘要遵循我们剧本中使用的OpenOOD公约. 近OD数据集以组数为平均值,远OD数据集以组数为平均值,报告的平均值为两组数. 表3所列10项具体攻击指标的横向汇总平均数。

blocks.en: A.2 Adversarial-shift protocol
blocks.zh: A.2 过渡性协议

blocks.en: For all attacks that require labels, the label source is the ImageNet ground-truth label of the source validation image. For all ℓ ∞ \ell_{\infty} attacks, we use ϵ = 4 / 255 \epsilon=4/255 . The attack objective is classifier misclassification under the frozen backbone. For Foolbox attacks this is the standard misclassification criterion, for AutoAttack variants it is the standard evaluation routine with the true ImageNet labels. After generation, the detector only sees the perturbed image and does not use labels. Table 3 summarizes the per-attack objective, norm and budget, and implementation details.

blocks.en: All branch scores are standardized using ID-only statistics. To avoid numerical instability from near-degenerate branches, the implementation applies a small standard-deviation floor of 10 − 6 10^{-6} before z-scoring. Probability computations in JS-TC use clamped probabilities for numerical stability. The fixed default hyperparameters are k m = 5 k_{m}=5 , p E = 0.90 p_{E}=0.90 , p BP = p C = 0.70 p_{\mathrm{BP}}=p_{C}=0.70 , softness s = 0.6 s=0.6 , temperature grid T , τ ∈ { 0.5 , 1.0 } T,\tau\in\{0.5,1.0\} , and transform pool { id , flip , crop 0.9 } \{\mathrm{id},\mathrm{flip},\mathrm{crop}_{0.9}\} . These values are selected without OOD labels. Sensitivity analyses over these constants are reported in Appendices E.1 , B.3 , and B.4 .

JS-TC中的概率计算使用夹住的概率实现数值稳定. 固定的默认超参数为km=5k_{m}=5,pE=0.90p_{E}=0.90,pBP=0.70p_{\mathrm{BP}}=p_{C}=0.70,软度S=0.6s=0.6,温度网T,\τ0.5,1.0}T,\tau\in\{0.5,1.0\},变池 {id,翻页,作物 0.9}\{\mathrm{flip},\mathrm{crop}_{0.9}. 这些值是在没有OD标签的情况下选择的. 附录E.1、B.3和B.4报告了对这些常数的敏感性分析。

blocks.en: Boundary-Probe backpropagates only to a chosen late feature representation and uses the model in evaluation mode. BatchNorm and LayerNorm statistics are not updated during scoring. The hook is placed on the last task-level representation before the classification head: the final residual/trunk representation for ResNet-50 and RegNet, the final class-token representation for ViT-B/16, the final pooled stage representation for Swin-T.

blocks.en: Table 4 isolates the branch definitions. In the energy family, class-centered energy is comparable to standard EBO but is not a uniformly stronger standalone detector. blocks.en: Table 5 isolates branch combinations. On clean-OOD, the full equal-weight fusion E+BP+TC and the gated TriScore detector are tied in aggregate FPR@95 after rounding, both reaching 53.5 53.5 . The equal-weight fusion is slightly better in AUROC, 82.9 82.9 versus 82.7 82.7 . Gating preserves the best clean-OOD FPR@95 of the fixed full fusion while remaining essentially comparable in AUROC.

blocks.en: On adversarial OOD, this pattern changes. TriScore gives the best aggregate FPR@95 and AUROC, improving over E+BP by 2.1 2.1 FPR@95 points and 1.8 1.8 AUROC points, and over E+BP+TC by 6.3 6.3 FPR@95 points and 3.9 3.9 AUROC points. The per-backbone results show the main exception: BP-only is stronger than TriScore on ResNet-50, where the energy branch is weak. On RegNet, ViT-B/16, and Swin-T, the gated fusion is stronger. We treat E+BP as a lower-cost clean-OOD option, E+BP+TC as the strongest fixed clean-OOD subset, and TriScore as the preferred adversarial-shift variant.

blocks.en: B.5 Runtime comparison
blocks.zh: B.5 运行时间比较

blocks.en: Table 10 reports wall-clock timings on a CIFAR-10 benchmark with a single NVIDIA H100 GPU. CIFAR-10 is used here as a manageable runtime benchmark. TriScore completes in 65.4 65.4 seconds including 3.3 3.3 seconds of ID-calibration setup. It is slower than single-forward scores such as MLS and EBO, and also slower than CADRef. It is faster than GEN and PRO, and dramatically faster than KNN. KNN’s nearest-neighbor search over the stored ID-training feature bank takes 5.8 × 5.8\times longer than TriScore, and this gap only widens at ImageNet scale, where the bank grows from CIFAR-10’s 50 50 k vectors to the 1.28 1.28 M ImageNet-1K training features ( 3.9 3.9 - 15.5 15.5 GB across the four backbones, scaling with the feature dimension). Even though other feature-based detectors (like ViM and CADRef) avoid searching the full feature bank at inference by storing summarized class-aware statistics or residual subspaces, they still require the ID-training data during setup. TriScore avoids this entirely: it is lighter, relies only on ID-validation statistics, stores one class-mean logit vector and a small set of scalar ID-validation statistics, and requires zero training data at deployment. PRO has negligible postprocessor setup in the table, but its total includes the APS evaluator-initialization sweep and input-gradient scoring. GEN is nominally a one-forward-pass score, but its generalized-entropy implementation has nontrivial per-batch post-processing overhead in this code path, so the table should be read as an implementation timing rather than a pure pass-count benchmark. Appendix A states which baseline setup costs are included.
blocks.zh: 表10以一个单一的NVIDIA H100 GPU的CIFAR-10基准报告时钟。 CIFAR-10在此用作可控运行时间基准. TriScore以65.4 65.4秒完成,包括3.3秒的ID校准设置. 它比MLS和EBO等单向分数慢,也比CADRef慢. 它比GEN和PRO更快,并且比KNN快得多。 KNN在存储的ID训练功能库上最近的邻里搜索需要比TriScore长5.8×5.8\的时间,这一缺口只在ImageNet规模上扩大,银行从CIFAR-10的50k向量增长到1.28 1.28 MImageNet-1K训练功能(3.9 3.9 - 15.5 15.5 GB横跨四个主干线,与特性维度缩放). 即使其他基于特征的探测器(如Vim和CADRef)避免通过存储汇总的类感知统计或剩余子空间来在推断时搜索完整特征库,但它们在设置时仍然需要ID训练数据. Triscore完全避免了这种情况:它比较轻,只依靠ID验证统计,存储一个类-正数向量和一套小的scalar ID验证统计,在部署时需要零训练数据. PRO在表中有可忽略不计的后处理器设置,但其总数包括APS评价器-初始化扫描和输入级积分. GEN名义上是一个一向前传的分数,但其普适执行在这个代码路径中具有非三角每批处理后管理费,因此该表应该被解读为一个执行时间,而不是纯粹的通过计数基准. 附 录 列入基线设置费用的国家。

blocks.en: TriScore therefore is a mid-cost post-hoc detector. It is more expensive than single-forward scores, but 5.8 × 5.8\times cheaper than KNN, slightly faster than the measured PRO path, and, unlike the feature-based detectors (KNN, ViM, CADRef), needs no ID-training-set access at deployment, and unlike KNN specifically, it stores and searches no feature bank.
blocks.zh: 因此,TriScore是中成本的后热探测器。 它比单向前的分数更贵,但5.8×5.8\时比KNN便宜,略快于所测量的PRO路径,并且与基于特性的探测器(KNN,Vim,CADRef)不同,在部署时不需要ID-train-set访问,与KNN具体不同的是,它存储和搜索没有特性库.

blocks.en: To separate the benefit of our triple from the general benefit of combining detectors, we fuse family-diverse trios of existing baselines under the identical ID-only pipeline. Each trio is evaluated with three combiners (equal-weight z-score averaging, our ID-residual gate, and rank aggregation), and Table 11 reports the best combiner per trio together with its four-backbone mean and worst-backbone AUROC. We also fuse an OOD-tuned logistic model as an out-of-setting reference which uses OOD labels, and to avoid training and testing on the same inputs it is fit on one disjoint half of each OOD split plus the ID calibration set and evaluated on the held-out half.

blocks.en: An important part of the gain is the general benefit of diverse fusion: the rank-aggregated GEN+KNN+MSP trio beats TriScore on ViT-B/16 and Swin-T. Three qualifications keep the specific design meaningful. (i) It is not any fusion as a bank-free, access-matched logit+gradient trio (GEN+GradNorm+MSP), fused under the same pipeline, reaches only 63.2 63.2 mean / 59.1 59.1 worst adversarial AUROC, below TriScore, and for the competitive trio, rank aggregation is the only combiner that lifts it above TriScore (its equal-weight and gated variants are lower). (ii) TriScore keeps the highest worst-backbone floor ( 62.1 62.1 vs the trio’s 61.1 61.1 ). (iii) The one trio that beats TriScore’s mean is carried by KNN, a 5.8 × 5.8\times inference slowdown ( 380.4 380.4 s vs 65.4 65.4 s, Table 10 ) and a 1.28 1.28 M-vector feature bank ( 3.9 3.9 - 15.5 15.5 GB) that must be stored and searched at inference. Hence, the comparison identifies a performance-resource trade-off. GEN+KNN+MSP buys the higher mean with a feature bank and training-set access, while TriScore keeps the higher floor bank-free. TriScore is a feature-bank- and training-data-free combination of logit, gradient, and transform-consistency cues.

(i) 作为无银行、接入匹配的对数+梯度三重管(GEN+GradNorm+MSP),在同一个管线下装配,仅达到63.2 63.2 平均值 / 59.1 59.1 最恶劣的对抗性AUROC,低于三重管(TriScore),对竞争性三重管来说,分级聚合是唯一将它提升到三重管(其同等重量和闸门变体较低)的组合体。 (二) TriScore保持最高最差背骨层(62.1 62.1对三重奏61.1 61.1 )。 (三) 击败TriScore中值的三重奏是由KNN携带的,一个5.8×5.8的推论减速(380.4380.4s vs 65.4 65.4s,表10)和一个必须按推论存储和搜索的1.28 1.28 M-vector特性库(3.9 3.9 - 15.5 15.5 GB). 因此,比较确定了业绩资源权衡。 GEN+KNN+MSP以功能库和培训设置访问方式购买更高层的均价,而TriScore则保持较高层的银行免费. blocks.en: On clean data, BP is largely redundant with uncertainty: it correlates strongly with MSP ( ρ ∈ [ − 0.88 , − 0.68 ] \rho\in[-0.88,-0.68] across backbones) and predicts ID misclassification at 74 74 - 81 81 AUROC, comparable to 1 − MSP 1-\mathrm{MSP} , while its MSP-orthogonal residual is near chance. Under adversarial shift, the picture changes: BP outperforms 1 − MSP 1-\mathrm{MSP} on all four backbones, and the frozen residual BP ∣ \mid MSP still separates OOD at 55 55 - 70 70 AUROC. Linear residualization only establishes orthogonality to a linear function of MSP on the fitting distribution, which shows that BP retains non-redundant ranking information beyond a linear function of MSP under attack.

blocks.en: E.3 Complementarity of the branches
blocks.zh: E.3 分支的互补性

blocks.en: Table 41 reports the Spearman rank correlation among the three standardized branches on clean ID data versus under PGD attack. On the transformer and RegNet backbones the branches are already weakly correlated on clean data (most pairwise ρ ≤ 0.5 \rho\leq 0.5 ) and stay weak-to-moderate under attack. On ResNet-50 they are more strongly correlated on clean data but several pairs decorrelate under attack (e.g. ρ ⁡ ( E , T ​ C ) \rho(E,TC) drops from 0.71 0.71 to 0.40 0.40 ). In neither regime is any pair strongly redundant, but correlation between continuous scores is only suggestive of complementarity. Table 42 therefore makes the detection-error overlap explicit at a matched operating point. Thresholding each branch at a common 5 % 5\% ID false-positive rate on the pooled adversarial splits, we report the fraction each branch detects, the fraction it detects uniquely (missed by the other two), and the gated fusion at a matched 5 % 5\% total ID FPR.

blocks.en: The results show two important points. First, no single branch dominates across backbones: the strongest branch is TC on ResNet-50, energy on RegNet, and BP on the transformers. Each branch uniquely flags 2 2 - 9 % 9\% of adversarial inputs that the other two miss, so their errors do not fully overlap. Second, at this stringent matched operating point, the gated fusion detects a fraction comparable to the best single branch. Its advantage is in ranking (AUROC, Table 1 ) and in cross-backbone robustness, because the strongest branch changes with the backbone and is not known a priori, so the gate tracks whichever branch is informative without having to select it. These results demonstrate that the branches are complementary and that the gate helps.
blocks.zh: 结果显示两点重要内容。 首先,没有单一的分支主导跨骨干:最强的分支是ResNet-50上的TC,RegNet上的能量,以及变压器上的BP. 每个分支独有地标出另外两个分支错失的对抗性输入的2 2-9% /% /%,所以它们的错误并不完全重叠. 第二,在这个严格匹配的操作点,门质聚变检测出一个与最佳单分支相当的分数. 它的优势在于排名(AUROC,表1)和交叉背骨稳健性,因为最强的分支随骨干而变化,而且不为人所知,所以无论哪个分支信息丰富,大门都会跟踪,而不必选择. 这些结果表明,这些分支是相辅相成的,大门也有帮助。
